column1: # Wave 2's names (docs/port/PCONLY.md 3 and 4): the last address names the C used that no map named, found by
# classify_c over the code of src/, include/, port/ and nonmatching/ (function bodies, initialisers, macros; not the
# m2c preambles' declarations). Evidence: the MAT3 decomp (symbols.txt, its C) and the code that uses each datum.
# The function-local statics that kept an address spelling were renamed by hand, as locals (their globals have rows
# in the area maps); the test fixtures of port/data/test_pc_data_decls.c are named for their addresses on purpose.
